d: Sean Fletcher finds tips and treats among the food producers in Cardiff Market, from making Indian street food to baking vegan cakes. Farmer Meinir Howells goes underground to reveal the secrets of cheese production in Harlech, and investigates the growing popularity of keeping chickens.

Join Edith Bowman and Colin Murray at the Stranraer Oyster Festival, as celebrations mark the start of the native oyster season. They sail into Loch Ryan to Scotland's largest oyster bed to discover why they're so special.

Sean Fletcher explores the Abergavenny food festival and discovers the secrets of barbequing success from passionate experts Sam and Shauna. Farmer Meinir Howells gets a workout harvesting cockles with fifth generation pickers in Carmarthenshire.
Adam explores Tottenham's football food culture with stadium lamb ravioli, Romanian honey cake and West African-inspired tapas before watching Spurs play.
Adam explores Manchester United's food scene with an epic seafood boil, a fine-dining steak bake and a sweet and savoury Honey Butter Ring.
Owner Keiko emigrated from Japan to Vancouver where she opened a bakery. Sadly, her sweet dream turned to a nightmare and now Steve will have to help her back on the path to success

Wannamakers family bakery run by Melanie and her daughters is on the verge of collapse with bills piling up and no business leadership. Steve will have to tackle their strained family dynamics to help them find sweet success.

Whitney is enthusiastic and talented but doesn't have much business and baking experience. Steve knows that baking from scratch will take her business to the next level so she can make her sweet dreams come true.
Little Cove Bakery in the tourist town of Tobermory, is languishing in the off-season. Owner Kelly has used up all her savings and will have to shut down if Steve can't turn her business around fast
Three talented baking teams transport the judges to a wintery landscape.
